structured_stats.description:
The '''DJ Booth''' is an advanced [[Towers|tower]] that is primarily a support tower with some economic and offensive capabilities through its ''Drop the Beat'' ability unlocked at Level 3. It can be bought from the store for {{Coins|5,000}}.

The '''DJ Booth''' provides boosts to towers in range through different tracks, which also changes the behavior of its ''Drop the Beat'' ability. 

The Purple track is unlocked on Level 0 and is active by default. It grants a 12.5% [[Range Buff]] to towers, which with Levels increases to up to 25%. When the ''Drop the Beat'' ability is used, it will create three (four at Level 5) pulses which knockback and slow down enemies. These can hit any enemy, regardless of immunities. The knockback is the regular knockback, meaning any immunity that prevents enemies from being knocked back, such as [[Stun Immunity]], will prevent the enemy from being knocked back. How far back the enemy is knocked back depends on its size. Bigger enemies will get pushed back a smaller distance than an average-sized enemy. However, only [[boss]] enemies are immune to the slowdown. The slowdown effectiveness is based on the number of towers in the '''DJ Booth's''' range, starting from 10% and increasing by 1% to up to 25%. At Level 5, base slowdown is increased to 10% and max slowness is increased to 35%. It applies a 10% [[Range Buff]] at Level 5 if the Purple track is not selected.

The Green track is unlocked on Level 0. It grants a 5% [[Discount Buff]] to towers, which with Levels increases to 15%. When the ''Drop the Beat'' ability is used, it will generate cash. There is a base amount of cash given, which is {{Money|250}}, which is increased by {{Money|35}} for every tower in range of the '''DJ Booth''', up to a total of {{Money|600}}. All three statistics are able increase to up to {{Money|750}} base cash, {{Money|75}} increase per tower and {{Money|2,250}}. It applies a 5% [[Discount Buff]] at Level 5 if the Green track is not selected.

The Red track is unlocked at Level 2. It grants a 10% [[Damage Buff]] to towers, which with Levels increases to 20%. When the ''Drop the Beat'' ability is used, it will create three (four at Level 5) pulses that deal 25 damage to enemies. It can damage hidden, lead and flying enemies. This damage increases to 50 at Level 5. The pulses also drops the defense of enemies. The base defense drop is 2%, which increases by 0.25% for every tower in the '''DJ Booth's''' range up to 10%. The pulses only drops defense once, as it cannot drop more defense than what its defense drop is. For example, if the Level 5 '''DJ Booth''' has 40 towers in its range, it will only drop 15% defense from a [[Fallen Hazmat]], making it have 45% defense. It applies a 7.5% [[Damage Buff]] at Level 5 if the Red track is not selected.

There is a limit of one '''DJ Booth''' per player.

==Description==
The '''DJ Booth Plush''' is an official Paradoxum Games toy. It is made by Juniper Creates™. The plushie offers the Default Level 4 [[DJ Booth]]. Anybody who bought the toy would be emailed a code 24 hours later, which allowed them to get the [[DJ Booth/Gallery#Plushie|{{Color|Other|Plushie}} DJ Booth]] skin. This is no longer the case after the 18th of May 2025.

It is made out of plush fabric and Polypropylene cotton. It is 11.8 inches (29.972 cm) tall, 7.8 inches (19.812 cm) wide and 7.5 inches (19.05 cm) deep. A tree is planted for every order of the '''DJ Booth Plush'''.

==Official Description==
*'''Online'''
*:Keep the party going this holiday season with '''DJ Booth Plush'''!

==Prices & Stores==
Prices vary by country due to shipping costs and local currency. The '''DJ Booth Plush''' can be purchased on the official [https://shop.paradoxum.games/ Paradoxum Games online store] for $34.99. It can also be purchased in a bundle with the pin based on the same tower, which normally cost together $47.98, but are discounted for 10% making the cost $43.18. It is currently unavailable.

Before April 2025, this could be purchased for $29.99, while the bundle could be purchased for $35.98. During the Black Friday 2024 Sale, it could be bought for $22.49, while the bundle had a cost of $23.83. Before April 2023, this could be purchased for $27.99.

==Description==
The '''Damage Buff''' is a buff that increases a tower's damage, making them stronger. It is displayed on the tower itself with the icon of an arm with muscle.

==Mechanics==
'''Damage Buff''' range reduction is calculated as:
::<big>'''Damage × (1 + Damage Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Damage Buff''' is the debuff supplied in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The damage increased by the '''Damage Buff''' will always round down to the nearest integer. For example, a tower that deals 5 damage with a 50% '''Damage Buff''' will deal 7 damage, instead of 7.5.

Multiple towers are not fully affected by the buff. A full list of towers affected fully, partially or that are unaffected can be found below.
{{DamageBuff}}

==Applied By==
The following towers or consumables can apply the '''Damage Buff''' to other towers or itself:
*[[DJ Booth]] (Passive)
*[[Mercenary Base]] (Passive)
*[[Damage Flag]] (Passive)
*[[War Machine]] (Passive)
*[[Medic]] (''Ubercharge'' ability)
*[[Warden]] (When parrying)

The following event features can apply the '''Damage Buff''' to towers:

* [[Justice]] (Passive, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
* [[The Chariot]] (Passive, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])

The following towers used to have the '''Damage Buff''':
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Crook Boss]] (Passive)
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]] (Passive)
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Pyromancer]] (Passive)
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Scout]] (Passive)
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Cowboy]] (Passive)
*[[Militant|John]] (''Enraging Shout'' ability)
*[[Slasher|Shredder]] (''Knife Throw'' ability)
*[[Cowboy]] (''Wildest of the West and Gold Rush'' abilities'')''
*[[Gladiator]] (''Sharp Edge'' ability'')''

The following tower used to apply the '''Damage Buff''' to other towers:
*[[Militant|John]] (''Enraging Shout'' ability)

The following removed towers had the '''Damage Buff''':
*{{Color|Platinum}} [[Crook Boss]] (Passive)
*{{Color|Platinum}} [[Minigunner]] (Passive)

}}

}}

==Description==
The '''Fatigue Debuff''' is a debuff that increases a tower's firerate, making them fire slower. It is displayed on the tower itself with the icon of a ball and chain.

==Mechanics==
Currently, the '''Fatigue Debuff''' is calculated as:

::<big>'''Original Firerate + Original Firerate × (Fatigue Debuff ÷ (1 + Fatigue Debuff))'''</big>
::: where '''Fatigue Debuff''' is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

While it may look like the firerate of a tower with the '''Firerate Debuff''' is rounded up or down to the second decimal, this is only visual. The number can be far longer than what is displayed.

The firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] is calculated as:

::<big>'''(Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) + (Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 + Fatigue Debuff ÷ (1 + Fatigue Debuff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>
:::where ''Bugged Firerate'' is the firerate with the [[Firerate Bug]].

Prior to the [[v1.1.0|Entity System Update]], '''Fatigue Debuff''' was calculated as:

::<big>'''Original Firerate × (1 + Firerate Debuff)'''</big>

The firerate of a tower with the [[Firerate Bug]] was calculated as:

::<big>'''((Bugged Firerate - [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]) × (1 + Fatigue Debuff)) + [[Firerate Bug|Firerate Bug Increase]]'''</big>

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Fatigue Debuff''':
*All towers that are not humanoids are immune to any debuff applied by enemies prior to the 28th of October 2023.
**The {{Color|Premium|XR500}} is still affected, as the skin has a humanoid.
**Multiple skins added starting from the 1st of April 2025 also have this immunity due to bugs.
*All [[units]].
*Firerate of secondary attacks, like the [[Pursuit]]'s missiles.
**Their main firerate can still be increased.
*Tick of effects applied to enemies.
**The tick of the [[Accelerator]] can still be increased.
*The rev-up times of various towers, like the [[Minigunner]] or [[Pursuit]]
*Charge-up and cooldown of various burst or burst adjacent attacks, such as the [[Soldier]], [[Freezer]] and [[Accelerator]].
*Ability cooldowns.

==Applied By==
The following consumables can apply the '''Fatigue Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Sugar Rush (Consumable)|Sugar Rush]] (Passive)

The following enemies can apply the '''Fatigue Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Boomer]] (''Weakening Bile'' ability)
*[[Clown]] (''Bombastic Performance'' ability)
*[[Tanker]] (''Toxic Fumes'' ability)
*[[Elite Boomer]] (''Weakening Bile'' ability)
*[[Molten Warlord]] (''Fireball'' ability)
*[[Fallen Soul (Legacy)|Fallen Soul]] (Legacy version, ''Slash'' ability)

==Description==
The '''Range Buff''' is a buff that increases a tower's range. It is shown on the tower with a blue icon of multiple waves.

==Mechanics==
'''Range Buff''' range reduction is calculated as:
::<big>'''Range × (1 + Range Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Range Buff''' is the buff supplied in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The range of a tower affected by the '''Range Buff''' can be in decimal form, instead of being rounded down or rounded up to the nearest interger. For example, a tower with 5 range with a 50% '''Range Buff''' will have a range of 7.5.

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Range Buff''':
*All [[units]].
*The [[Shotgunner]], as its bullets do not extend into the increased range.
*The [[DJ Booth]] cannot have its range boosted by another [[DJ Booth]].
**Other range buff sources, like the [[Ranger]], can still apply it.
*Circling range of the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]].
**The radius in which towers gain hidden detection from the [[Ace Pilot]] also cannot be increased.
**These towers' attack range can still be increased.
*The sentry building range of the [[Engineer]].
*The deadzone ranges of towers like the [[Biologist]] and [[Engineer]].
**The attack range for these towers can still be increased.
*Secondary orange range of towers like the range buff range for the [[Ranger]] or the gravestone range for the [[Necromancer]].
**The main range of these towers can still be increased.
*The chain range of the [[Electroshocker]].
**The attack range can still be increased.
*The explosion radius from [[Splash Damage|Splash Damage towers]] cannot be increased.

==Applied By==
The following towers or consumables can apply the '''Range Buff''' to other towers:
*[[DJ Booth]] (Passive)
*[[Ranger]] (Passive for 20 seconds at the beginning of each wave)
*[[Range Flag]] (Passive)
*[[UAV]] (Passive)
*[[Easter Egg]] (Passive for 20 seconds)
The following event features can apply the '''Range Buff''' to towers:

* [[The Moon]] (Passive, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])

The following towers used to have the '''Range Buff''':
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Pyromancer]] (Passive)
*{{Color|Golden}} [[Cowboy]] (Passive)
*[[Slasher]] (Old ''Knife Throw'' ability)

The following removed towers had the '''Range Buff''':
*{{Color|Platinum}} [[Pyromancer]] (Passive)

==Description==
The '''Scared Debuff''' is a debuff that decreases a tower's range. It is displayed on the tower itself using the icon of a ghost. Multiple ghosts will also appear out of the tower.

==Mechanics==
'''Scared Debuff''' range reduction is calculated as:
::<big>'''Range × (1 - Scared Debuff)'''</big>
:::where '''Scared Debuff''' is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The range of a tower affected by the '''Scared Debuff''' can be in decimal form, instead of being rounded down or rounded up to the nearest integer. For example, a tower with 5 range with a 50% '''Scared Debuff''' will have a range of 2.5.

The following towers are either partially or fully not affected by the '''Scared Debuff''':
*All towers that are not humanoids are immune to any debuff applied by enemies prior to the 28th of October 2023.
**Multiple skins added starting from the 1st of April 2025 also have this immunity due to bugs.
*All [[units]]..
*Circling/patrol range of the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]].
**The radius in which towers gain hidden detection from the [[Ace Pilot]] also cannot be decreased.
**These towers' attack range can still be decreased.
*The deadzone ranges of towers, like the [[Engineer]].
**The attack range for these towers can still be decreased.
*Secondary orange range of towers like the range buff range for the [[Ranger]] or the gravestone range for the [[Necromancer]].
**The main range of these towers can still be decreased.
*The chain range of the [[Electroshocker]].
**The attack range can still be decreased.
*The explosion radius from [[Splash Damage|Splash Damage towers]] cannot be decreased.

==Applied By==
The following enemies can apply the '''Scared Debuff''' to towers:

==Description==
The '''Discount Buff''' is a buff that decreases a tower's upgrade and ability usage costs. This does not decrease the placement cost of a tower. The buff is displayed on the affected towers using an icon of a green tag.

==Mechanics==
When applied, all upgrade costs and ability usage costs will be reduced using this equation:
::<big>'''Cost × (1 - Discount Buff)'''</big>
:::where '''Discount Buff''' is the buff supplied in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1).

The upgrade cost is rounded down to the nearest integer. Towers that were upgraded while being affected the '''Discount Buff''' will give you less cash back when they are sold, in comparison to those that were not affected by it. The sell prices are permanently affected.

The following towers cannot have their costs partially or fully decreased by the '''Discount Buff''':
*[[Farm]]

==Applied By==
The following tower can apply the '''Discount Buff''' to other towers:
*[[DJ Booth]] (Passive)

Build up chill to slow and freeze enemies in their tracks!|Store Description}} |-|Version 3 = {{QuoteBox|Chill enemies to a slow freeze!|Store Description}} |-|Version 2 = {{QuoteBox|Shoot an ice beam, freezing targets for a few seconds.|Store Description}} |-|Version 1 = {{QuoteBox|Freeze zombies temporarily with a freeze ray!|Former Store Description}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Freezer''' is a ground [[Towers|tower]] that fires an ice beam and applies chill and slow down enemies, freezing at later levels. It can be bought in the store for {{Coins|650}}. The '''Freezer''' targets a single enemy and fires a ''Frost Ray'', chilling the enemy and slowing it down. The chillness slowness effect stacks with each hit multiple times. This chillness effect also deals damage over time, chipping away the health of enemies affected by it. Starting from Level 2, it can freeze enemies. When the chillness slowness effect is higher than the max slowdown, the enemy will be frozen, which generally when targeting a single enemy takes four or five shots. Larger enemies will be frozen for a shorter amount of time than average sized enemies. Enemies with [[Freeze Immunity]] also cannot be frozen, slowed down or have their defense dropped by the '''Freezer'''. At Level 3+, the '''Freezer''' fires in bursts, with a short delay between them. Additionally, at Level 3+, it drops defense by 10% every tick. It can only decrease an enemy's defense by 33%. For example, if an enemy has 50% defense, it will be decreased by 16%. On top of this, it will also start dealing damage over time with its chill at Level 3. Additionally at Level 4, the '''Freezer''' gains the ability to throw a '''Frost Grenade''', freezing enemies within an explosion radius. The '''Freezer''' does well as an all-rounder support tower. Due to its generally low price and decent DPS, the '''Freezer''' can be a solid choice for early-game defense to mid game with very good cost efficiency. Towards late game, the '''Freezer''' is useful for stalling, defense melting and deal additional DPS through its damage over time, though its DPS is insufficient to deal with late-game waves alone. The '''Freezer''' has [[Lead (Attribute)|lead]] detection from Level 0 and [[Hidden (Attribute)|hidden]] detection from level 2.
